description: Experiments in the areas of mechanics, electricity and magnetism, and materials science. Emphasis is on the development of good laboratory techniques, analytical skills, and the ability to work independently. Each 0.25-course registration includes one three-hour laboratory per week. Offered annually in the spring semester. Prerequisite: concurrent registration in (or previous completion of) PHYS 245.
name: Advanced Physics Laboratory I
notes: Open to Seniors and Juniors only.
prerequisites: concurrent registration in (or previous completion of) PHYS 245.
